findings.description: TLS 1.0/1.1 and SSLv3 are deprecated by every major standard and fail PCI DSS 4.0 requirement 4.2.1; CBC padding and downgrade handling in these versions have practical attacks against them.
findings.remediation: Set `minprocversion`/`ssl protocol` to TLSv1.2 minimum, prefer TLSv1.3, and disable RSA key-exchange and non-AEAD cipher suites.

findings.description: Anything responding that the CMDB does not know about is either unmanaged, unpatched, or intentionally installed by someone. Each case needs an owner, an OS baseline and a patch plan.

evidence.text: 192.168.1.7 () type=unknown vendor= not present in the inventory export

findings.remediation: Identify the owner from DHCP leases/switch port + MAC OUI, then either add it to inventory with a security baseline or remove it from the network.
